svg.title: Manitoba Basic Autopac versus Extension choices
svg.desc: Basic Autopac third-party liability is 500,000 dollars. From 1 April 2026 the Basic physical-damage deductible is 1,000 dollars. Extension can raise liability to 1, 2, or 5 million dollars and can buy the deductible down. Autopac is invalid in Mexico.
svg.text: Where Basic stops and Extension starts
MPI pages used 24 Sep 2026. The 2026/27 year began 1 April 2026.
$1 million, $2 million, or $5 million. $7 million and $10 million ended 1 July 2025.
Driver Safety Rating level +20: 53% off vehicle insurance and 55% off driver insurance.
MPI statement on the 2026/27 Public Utilities Board order. One level on the scale, not a promise for every driver.
Canada and the United States are the driving territory. Autopac is invalid while the vehicle is in Mexico.
Stopping a payment does not cancel registration. Bind the next province before you create a bare day.
Basic is compulsory MPI. Extension is optional inside Autopac, not an Alberta-style private market.
